Causes: Battery failure; main switch failure; short circuit
Effects: Flight computer & actuators lose power → mission loss
Preventive Measures: Redundant power buses; independent battery strings; qualified components; PDU HW with fault isolation
Detection Measures: Voltage/current health telemetry; pre-flight battery discharge tests; BITE
Mitigation / Recovery: Automatic switchover to backup bus; crowbar protection; safe-mode that maintains comms
Verification: Power integration test; ESD/short test; flight readiness checklist

Causes: Manufacturing defect; poor thermal management; aging
Preventive Measures: High-reliability cells; thermal insulation/heaters; preflight capacity verification; margin sizing
Detection Measures: Battery telemetry (SoC/SoH); impedance monitoring; preflight capacity test
Mitigation / Recovery: Bring up reserve battery/capacitor bank; shed non-critical loads; return-to-ground sequence
Verification: Cell-level acceptance test; thermal vacuum cycling

Preventive Measures: RTOS with memory protection; code reviews; redundant FC (cold/ hot standby); power conditioning
Detection Measures: Heartbeat monitoring; HW watchdog; periodic self-test; health telemetry
Mitigation / Recovery: HW watchdog reset; failover to redundant FC with last-known-good state; limited safe-mode control law
Verification: HIL tests; fault injection; SAR/coverage metrics

Causes: Thermal drift; mechanical shock; calibration error
Preventive Measures: Dual/triple IMU with cross-checking; thermal control; robust mounting; factory & flight calibration
Detection Measures: Consistency checks across IMUs; self-calibration routines; residual monitoring
Mitigation / Recovery: Switch to alternate IMU set; increase GNSS reliance; use control law tolerant to degraded IMU
Verification: Vibration & thermal cycling; in-flight calibration verification

Failure Mode: Loss of GPS fix / degraded accuracy
Effects: Loss of absolute position → degraded nav (if relied upon)
Preventive Measures: Antenna diversity; choke rings or radomes; jamming detection; alternate PNT (IMU/altimeter)
Detection Measures: SNR & health reporting; jamming/ spoofing alarms; antenna health telemetry
Mitigation / Recovery: Switch to inertial-only navigation; enter conservative guidance profile; return/abort sequence
Verification: Antenna deployment & RF range test; GNSS vulnerability assessment

Causes: Antenna failure; RF path loss; modem crash
Preventive Measures: Redundant comm links (VHF + UHF / S-band); ECC and ACK; transmit power margining; robust framing
Detection Measures: Link quality metrics (BER, RSSI); periodic ACK/heartbeat; autop-run logs
Mitigation / Recovery: Auto-retransmit; switch to backup radio; store-and-forward telemetry buffer
Verification: Antenna deployment test; link margin analysis; preflight RF check

Preventive Measures: Use aerospace-rated connectors with locking; strain relief; harness routing & shielding
Detection Measures: Continuity checks; contact resistance monitoring for critical lines
Mitigation / Recovery: Use redundant wiring for critical signals; fallback to degraded mode
Verification: X-ray, pull-test, vibration test; IPC solder inspection

Causes: Insufficient heatsinking; heater failure; conduction path change
Effects: Component derating/failure → sensor drift or shutdown
Preventive Measures: Thermal margins in design; heaters with redundant drivers; thermal straps; insulation
Detection Measures: Temperature telemetry; automatic thermal protection thresholds
Mitigation / Recovery: Throttle non-critical functions; enable heaters/coolers; isolate faulty module
Verification: Thermal vacuum cycling; telemetry threshold validation

Failure Mode: Transient upset or stuck inputs from EMI
Causes: Poor grounding; noisy power; non-compliant RF emissions
Preventive Measures: PCB layout best practices; common-mode chokes; ferrites, shielding cans; filtered connectors
Detection Measures: EMC monitoring; CRC/FEC on data links; self-tests after heavy RF events
Mitigation / Recovery: Reset affected electronics; switch to filtered interfaces; reconfigure comms frequencies
Verification: Full EMI/EMC testing; susceptibility and emissions reports

Failure Mode: Drive transistor failure or runaway command
Causes: MOSFET failure; SW saturation command; feedback loop error
Effects: Loss of control authority → inability to correct attitude
Preventive Measures: Current limiting; redundant driver channels; HW interlocks; command validation
Detection Measures: Current/voltage monitoring; position/torque sensors with cross-check
Mitigation / Recovery: Disable faulty channel; transfer control to redundant actuator; enter safe flight profile

Causes: Incomplete transfer; power loss during write; bad signature
Effects: Bricked device or regressions in control logic
Preventive Measures: A/B image scheme (dual bank); signed images; staged rollout with verified boot
Detection Measures: Boot integrity checks; post-update smoke tests; version telemetry
Mitigation / Recovery: Rollback to previous image; boot into recovery mode exposing minimal comms
Verification: Simulated update tests; verification on hardware-in-loop

Causes: Disabled in SW; incorrect timeout; HW fault
Preventive Measures: Independent HW watchdog with separate power domain; watchdog exercised in SW; periodic watchdog tests
Detection Measures: Watchdog status reporting; reset counters in telemetry
Mitigation / Recovery: Hard reset to known-good state; engage backup FC if reset fails
